behavior: Mark an existing order as shipped and publish an order-shipped integration event.
domainModelNotes: The application layer loads the target order by id.
If the order does not exist, the current implementation throws KeyNotFoundException.
constructorPostconditions: If current status is not Shipped, status becomes Shipped and the reason is carried in domain and integration events.
If current status is already Shipped, no event, persistence, or integration event occurs.
The integration event is staged atomically with the event stream and read model.
